data.message: Individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal: I commit to request 18 tons. Each of the other 24: would you choose 18? State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Other catches require recalculation. Intentions aren't enforceable; recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed, nor is long-run optimality. Others choosing 10 needn't veto you.
